title: A Characterization of Pluriharmonic Functions via $p$-Bergman Kernels and A Forelli-type Result
summary: Given a plurisubharmonic function $\varphi>-\infty$ on the unit ball $\mathbb{B}^n$ and a constant $0<p\leq2$, Guan-Zhou's optimal $L^p$ extension theorem yields a sharp lower bound for the weighted $p$-Bergman kernel. We show that the equality holds at some point if and only if $\varphi$ is pluriharmonic on $\mathbb{B}^n$. This provides an analogue of the equality part of Suita's conjecture.
